newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-RUSSIA INFLATION UNCHANGED IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-RUSSIA INFLATION UNCHANGED IN WEEK.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have registered no increase at all in the week ended August 11, after remaining unchanged in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of August would be zero percent, compared with 0.9 percent in July.
If current price trends continue the inflation rate in the first eight months of 1997 will be 9.6 percent.
